build_modular_pipeline_from_pretrained: build a ModularPipeline from a Hugging Face Hub repo using from_pretrained with optional components_manager
run_modular_pipeline_call: run a ModularPipeline by calling it with inputs as kwargs and optional output parameter to select return values
load_modular_pipeline_components: load specific or all from_pretrained components of a ModularPipeline using load_components with optional dtype overrides
update_modular_pipeline_components: update components or config values of an instantiated ModularPipeline using update_components with new model instances
save_modular_pipeline_pretrained: save a ModularPipeline and all its from_pretrained components to a directory or push to Hugging Face Hub using save_pretrained
